title: Nehar De Pasey
body:
Haye Abbas Haye Haye Abbas
Nehar dey pasey tur peya maalik daryawaan da..
Zainab da sher bhira, Ghazi alma wala, nigran ridawaan da..
Sham waley vi ne puchde Ke, Ae bachi kon aay,
Pear kyun zakhmi ney, rukh tey kaada kyun ney,
Sab haal tamacheyan nal, neeley rukhsaaran tey,
tehreer aay rahwaan da..
Zeen toun leh gaye karbal Che, oh ek ek kar Ke,
Fatima jae nu, sainr kehndey jehrey,
Chan Umal Baneen dey san, Zainab nu maan reya, jina chaar bhirawaan da..
Hasdey loka nu rahwaan cho,
hatawan keewain,
Waal khilran jey tey keewain samanr dowain
Kalsoom tey Zainab tey, aj waila aaya aay, Abbas di bahwaan da..
Sir nu Abbas dey Saqlain aay si Zainab kehndi
Qaidi hathaan dey nal badla laa gi Ghazi
Jado sham ch jaaway gi mul Zainab paway gi
Ghazi teri bahwaan da..
